verdict.rationale: A government service that collects filer and voter data could plausibly publish a policy limiting use of that data for AI training, so this privacy-posture axis applies. The evidence pack covers only business filings, searches, open-data portals and tax pages. Nothing in it documents an AI-training opt-out or any data-use restriction.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
